specialtyCallout.title: Why AWS's Specialty tier is shrinking
specialtyCallout.content: Database, Data Analytics and SAP Specialty retired in April 2024; Machine Learning Specialty retired March 2026; Advanced Networking Specialty retires December 31, 2026. After that, Security Specialty is the only Specialty-tier exam remaining. Note AWS opened a new Business-track beta exam, AI Business Strategist (AIF-C01), reflecting a shift toward role-based and AI-focused certifications rather than domain specialties.
